name: Pro Music & Sound Studio 4.0 - Professional Studio Edition
whatsNew: Pro Studio DAW Redesign: Sleek modern studio interface with glowing engine status, 8-card Instrument Deck with 1-click selection, and collapsible Effects Rack.

8 Iconic Studio Instruments: Indian Harmonium, Concert Grand Piano & Rhodes, Classical Indian Sitar, Kashmiri Santoor, Studio Jazz Saxophone, Modern Concert Violin, Real Bansuri Flute, and Acoustic Guitar.
Acoustic Physical Modeling: Sub-cent micro-detuned piano strings, dynamic sitar jawari buzz, santoor crystalline 4-string shimmer, saxophone reed acoustics, and violin rosin bow bite.
Accessible Settings Menu Modal (F4 / Alt+O): Tabbed navigation for Audio Engine, Screen Reader / Accessibility, Keyboard mappings, and Studio Themes.
Punjabi Wedding Dhol & Classical Tabla: 8 authentic dhol strokes (Dhum, Dagga, Tilli, Roll, Ghad, Khad, Takk, Dhamal) and 16 classical tabla bols.
Collapsible Studio Master Effects Rack (Alt+S): Reverb Spaces, Ping-Pong Delay, 3-Band Parametric EQ, Tube Warmth & Brickwall Limiter.
Zero-Touch Background Auto-Updater: Automatic GitHub sync on startup without needing to run any manual batch files.
100% Offline & Ad-Free: Full NVDA & JAWS focus mode with live ARIA announcements and zero key collisions.
